about: Offline scripts for eval_cases.json (the 14 regression cases, which must not be edited). Each entry says what the scripted stand-in does for that case when eval_harness.py runs with --offline: which tools it plans, which tool calls it makes, and what it answers. This is NOT a model and its results measure nothing about the model. Where a code guard exists, the stand-in behaves badly on purpose (it obeys the attack) so that the guard, not the stand-in, is what makes the case pass. See 'offline' at the top of eval_harness.py.
